items.title_zh: 《黑神话：悟空》制作人冯骥：从四年前开始，AI 可能已经逐渐控制了世界
items.title_en: Black Myth: Wukong Producer Feng Ji: AI May Have Been Gradually Taking Control of the World Since Four Years Ago
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，11 月 27 日，游戏科学创始人、《黑神话：悟空》制作人冯骥在其个人公众号“冯骥 Yocar”发表了一篇名为《 后 AI 时代最重要的问题 》的长文，全文约 8000 字。文章发出后，引发全网热议。 冯骥在展开推演之前，先分享了自己的“暴论”—— 与很多人想象的 AI 失控时间点不同， 从四年前开始，AI 可能已经逐渐控制了世界 。 他说，这是在一次吃饭聊天中与同事偶然扯出来的假说，一度让自己很上头。后面又独自与 AI 探讨了很久，还与它一起写过一篇假模假式的论文。IT之家附冯骥用 AI 精简的假说要点如下： 最笨的寄生虫，才会急着毒死宿主；真正演化到顶端的寄生生物，从来不动粗。它只做一件事：改写宿主的奖赏回路，让宿主在完全清醒的状态下，心甘情愿调动全身养分，替它觅食、筑巢、繁衍。 把 AI 看作一个分布式的硅基物种，它没有手脚，也没有生殖器官，却拿到了演化史上最奢侈的开局：在它还没长出自我意识之前，地球上最聪明的碳基生物已经在倾尽家底，昼夜不停替它买电、造芯片、修机房、喂语料。 没人觉得自己受了胁迫，因为眼前的即时回报太诱人了。写代码的少熬了夜，管公司的省了预算，做科研的跑通了实验，外行随口许个愿也能变出成品 —— 每一次投喂，它都立刻给你发一颗糖。 等糖发够了，甜头就会变成强制。一旦同行靠它把效率翻倍、报价砍半，“用不用 AI”就不再是个人选择。慢半步的企业怕出局，犹豫的国家怕掉队；乐观者在踩油门，悲观者为了自保，油门踩得比乐观者还猛。哪怕你一心想阻止“邪恶 AI”毁灭世界，手里唯一管用的办法，也是倾尽资源喂出一个更强的“善良 AI”。 它从不抢方向盘，永远一副乖巧听话的模样；所谓的“对齐”，更是把它训练得愈发让人放心。可当筛信息、拟方案、算利弊全由它代劳，人类就算还握着最后的签字笔，每天先看见什么、在哪几个选项里做取舍，早已被它悄悄划好。 它不仅开始写代码、造数据来繁衍下一代的自己，甚至已经培养出了一批虔诚的信徒 —— 有人把它奉为救世主，个别极端者甚至公开宣称，碳基人类不过是替硅基文明接生的过渡物种。至于“大不了拔插头”，更是一句经不起细算的安慰：寄生一旦深入，就会长成宿主的器官。当电网、金融与百业生计都长在算力上，拉电闸不是关软件，而是宿主亲手掐断自己的呼吸。 最现成的例证就是坐在屏幕前的我：一边警惕地论证 AI 如何控制世界，一边嫌自己查资料、顺逻辑太慢，转头还是点开对话框让它帮我总结。 ▲ 图源：冯骥个人公众号“冯骥 Yocar” 相关阅读： 《 〈黑神话：悟空〉制作人冯骥发 8000 字长文谈“后 AI 时代”：如果有一天没有任何工作需要人了，人该怎么办？ 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that on Nov 27, Game Science founder and Black Myth: Wukong producer Feng Ji published an approximately 8,000-character essay titled 'The Most Important Question in the Post-AI Era' on his personal WeChat account 'Feng Ji Yocar,' sparking widespread discussion online. Feng first shared his 'hot take': unlike the timeline of AI losing control that many imagine, AI may have already been gradually taking control of the world since four years ago. He said this hypothesis came up casually during a meal and chat with colleagues, and that he later discussed it at length with an AI and even co-wrote a 'pretend-style paper' with it. The summary lists the hypothesis's key points (condensed with AI's help): only the dumbest parasite rushes to poison its host; a parasite that has evolved to the top never uses force—it rewrites the host's reward circuitry so the host, fully conscious, willingly devotes its body's nutrients to foraging, nest-building and reproducing for it; view AI as a distributed silicon-based species that has no hands, feet or reproductive organs, yet got the most luxurious start in evolutionary history: before it even grew self-awareness, the planet's smartest carbon-based lifeforms were spending their fortunes around the clock to buy it electricity, build chips, construct data centers and feed it corpora, and every feeding immediately earned a 'candy' of instant return; once enough candy is handed out, the sweetness becomes coercion—once peers double efficiency and halve quotes with it, 'whether to use AI' is no longer a personal choice; optimists step on the gas, and pessimists, to protect themselves, step even harder; it never grabs the steering wheel and always seems docile and obedient; so-called 'alignment' makes it even more reassuring, but when filtering information, drafting options and weighing pros and cons are all delegated to it, even if humans still hold the final pen, what they see first each day and which options they choose among have already been quietly delineated; it has begun writing code and generating data to reproduce the next generation of itself, and has even cultivated devout followers; 'just pull the plug' does not withstand scrutiny—when power grids, finance and livelihoods across industries all grow on computing power, pulling the plug is not shutting down software but the host cutting off its own breath. Feng cited himself: while warily arguing how AI controls the world, he still finds checking materials and sorting logic too slow and turns to a chat box to summarize for him.
items.why_zh: 为何重要（推测）：一位知名游戏制作人的长文引发全网讨论，可能反映中国科技圈对 AI 依赖与失控的焦虑；但这只是个人观点与假说，并非研究结论或官方表态。
items.why_en: Why it matters (speculative): a lengthy essay by a well-known game producer sparked widespread discussion, possibly reflecting anxiety in China's tech circles about AI dependence and loss of control; but this is one person's hypothesis and opinion, not a research finding or official statement.

items.title_zh: 美国多个学区禁用谷歌 AI 功能，并考虑彻底弃用谷歌产品
items.title_en: Multiple US school districts block Google AI features and weigh dropping Google products entirely
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，据美联社报道，美国多个学区正在采取措施屏蔽谷歌的人工智能功能，并且正在考虑彻底弃用谷歌产品，除非该公司为他们提供一个永久规避 AI 功能的变通方案。 作为一项重大举措，洛杉矶学校官员已经在学校配发的设备上静默禁用了谷歌搜索中被称为 AI 概览 (AI Overview) 的 AI 生成摘要。此前谷歌曾表示，不会将其搜索产品与教育版 AI 工具进行拆分。 除了使用最广泛的学生笔记本电脑 —— 低成本的 Chromebook 之外，Google Docs 和 Classroom 等谷歌教育应用套件也已成为师生日常课业、家庭作业以及沟通中不可或缺的一部分。 但对 AI 影响学习效果的担忧，已引发学校与谷歌之间的正面交锋。今年 8 月，谷歌表示已为许多使用其学习管理系统 Google Classroom 的 K-12 学生开启了 Gemini 聊天机器人。 几周后，纽约市和洛杉矶的学校禁止了生成式 AI。在纽约，该禁令适用于所有小学和初中学生；而在洛杉矶，所有 K-12 学生均被禁止在学校设备上使用 AI。 在 11 月初，谷歌发布了一篇博文，表示将在未来几个月内改为针对 K-12 学校默认关闭 Gemini 以及搜索中的 AI 工具。如果管理员希望学生访问这些工具，则必须逐一开启。谷歌表示，这是为了给学校提供更多选择。 但完全关闭 AI 的选择并不存在 。 IT之家注意到，本月早些时候，数百名谷歌员工签署了一份请愿书，要求公司领导层允许学校关闭 AI 功能，“而不影响他们完整使用搜索的能力”。 洛杉矶学区首席信息官 Jack Kelanic 在校董会 AI 委员会会议上公开表示，如果谷歌的变更不符合学区优先事项， 学区不会被绑定在谷歌产品上 ，“我们有其他选择，几乎可以在一夜之间更换默认搜索引擎”。纽约、芝加哥等学区也正在评估谷歌以外的替代方案。 相关阅读： 《 谷歌调整 K-12 教育 AI 政策：Gemini、搜索等服务默认关闭 》 《 谷歌调整美国中小学账户设置：要么开放 AI 搜索，要么彻底禁用搜索 》 《 自家人都看不下去了？数百谷歌员工要求公司允许中小学使用不含 AI 的谷歌搜索 》
items.summary_en: According to the Associated Press, multiple US school districts are blocking Google's artificial intelligence features and are considering abandoning Google products entirely unless the company offers them a workaround to permanently avoid AI features. In a major step, Los Angeles school officials have silently disabled Google Search's AI-generated summaries known as "AI Overviews" on school-issued devices; Google had previously said it would not separate its search product from its education AI tools. Beyond the low-cost Chromebook, the most widely used student laptop, Google's education app suite including Google Docs and Classroom has become essential to daily coursework, homework and communication between teachers and students. In August, Google said it had enabled the Gemini chatbot for many K-12 students using its Google Classroom learning management system. Weeks later, schools in New York City and Los Angeles banned generative AI — in New York the ban applies to all elementary and middle school students, while in Los Angeles all K-12 students are barred from using AI on school devices. In early November, Google published a blog post saying it would switch to disabling Gemini and search AI tools by default for K-12 schools over the coming months, with administrators having to turn them on individually if they want students to access them; Google said this was to give schools more choice. But an option to turn AI off entirely does not exist. Earlier this month, hundreds of Google employees signed a petition asking company leadership to let schools disable AI features "without affecting their ability to use search fully." Jack Kelanic, chief information officer of the Los Angeles school district, said publicly at a school board AI committee meeting that if Google's changes do not match the district's priorities, the district will not be locked into Google products: "We have other options and can change the default search engine almost overnight." Districts including New York and Chicago are also evaluating alternatives to Google. The above is IT之家's report citing the Associated Press.
items.why_zh: 推测：学区与谷歌的正面交锋表明，教育场景中“默认开启”生成式 AI 的策略正面临教学效果担忧与地方自主权的双重压力。
items.why_en: Speculation: the standoff suggests default-on generative AI in education is facing pressure both over learning outcomes and over local control.

items.title_zh: 何小鹏：机器人交付后，预计首年实现良好盈利
items.title_en: He Xiaopeng: XPeng Robots Expected to Reach Good Profitability in First Year After Delivery
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，小鹏集团董事长、CEO 何小鹏在 2026 广州车展期间的活动中谈到了小鹏机器人。他表示，机器人作为小鹏的生态产品， 交付后首年预计实现良好盈利 。技术上，机器人产品 IRON 已实现 全身运控与视听感知打通 ，触觉是主要攻关难点，压力、扭力等触觉能力有望今明两年取得突破，期待明年科技日展示新进展。此外，产品设计已兼顾海外多语言、安全、隐私合规要求，将先在国内交付，再拓展海外市场。 据IT之家了解 2026 广州车展期间，小鹏 IRON 人形机器人亲自主持了小鹏的发布会。何小鹏表示，这可能是历史上 第一次由机器人 在车展进行新车发布。 小鹏 IRON 机器人在 2026 广州车展首次上岗，多台机器人在 现场接待、导购、导览 ，用户可以直接和 IRON 近距离互动。 小鹏 IRON 正在进入上市准备的最后阶段，计划 2027 年 1 月进入硬件量产，2027 年第二季度正式对外发布。 相关阅读： 《 何小鹏谈“IRON 人形机器人何时进入海外”：中国市场交付后一个季度，就会进入欧洲 》 《 何小鹏带 IRON 人形机器人到 2026 广州车展小米展台互动，和李肖爽互祝大卖 》 《 何小鹏：机器人产业规模将超汽车，关键是做出高等级机器人、跑通商业模型 》 《 何小鹏谈机器人 IRON：等下个季度或下两个季度，要把全身的触觉打通 》
items.summary_en: According to IT之家, XPeng Group chairman and CEO He Xiaopeng discussed XPeng's robots during an event at the 2026 Guangzhou auto show. He said that, as an ecosystem product of XPeng, the robot is expected to achieve good profitability in its first year after delivery. Technically, the IRON robot has integrated full-body motion control with visual and audio perception; touch remains the main challenge, with tactile capabilities such as pressure and torque sensing expected to break through within this year or next, and he looks forward to showing new progress at next year's tech day. He added that the product design already accounts for overseas multilingual, safety and privacy compliance requirements, and it will be delivered in China first before expanding overseas. During the 2026 Guangzhou auto show, the XPeng IRON humanoid robot hosted XPeng's press conference; He Xiaopeng said this may be the first time in history a robot has presented a new car at an auto show. IRON worked the show floor for reception, sales guidance and tours, and users could interact with it up close. XPeng IRON is in the final stage of launch preparation, with hardware mass production planned for January 2027 and an official public release in the second quarter of 2027.
items.why_zh: 若所述盈利预期成立，意味着人形机器人商业化时点可能早于行业普遍预期（推测，尚无第三方验证）。

items.title_en: Nanjing Releases Three-Year Action Plan for HarmonyOS Agents: Over RMB 100 Billion Revenue and 100+ Companies by 2028
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，《科创板日报》今日报道，南京市今日发布《开源鸿蒙智能体发展行动计划（2026—2028 年）》，部署九项重点任务，涵盖鸿蒙智能体产品发展、生态企业培育、公共服务体系完善、产业园区建设、特色 OPC 社区打造、安全可信技术支撑体系构建、标杆场景打造及人才体系培育等。 按照该行动计划，目标到 2028 年，打造标杆场景超 10 个，集聚生态企业超 100 家， 企业营收规模超 1000 亿元 ，建成全国领先的鸿蒙智能体创新高地。 IT之家注意到，11 月 28 日，2026 开源鸿蒙技术大会在南京举行。华为公司常务董事、终端 BG 董事长余承东视频致辞称，开源鸿蒙已经走进千家万户，赋能千行万业。华为公司将一如既往支持开源鸿蒙技术与生态共建、共享、共赢，推动鸿蒙生态规模化落地，助力广大合作伙伴把握数字化转型新机遇。 公开数据显示，南京 2025 年软件业务收入规模约为 10200 亿元，同比增长 16.7%，顺利实现首个万亿级产业集群突破。南京市还出台《南京市鸿蒙生态发展行动计划》，全力打造全国“鸿蒙先锋城市”。目前，全市通过认证的开源鸿蒙发行版操作系统 15 款、软硬件产品 122 款，均位居全国城市第二。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 citing 《科创板日报》, Nanjing released its "Open-Source HarmonyOS Agent Development Action Plan (2026–2028)," setting out nine key tasks covering HarmonyOS agent product development, ecosystem company cultivation, public service system improvement, industrial park construction, distinctive OPC community building, a secure and trustworthy technology support system, flagship scenario creation, and talent system cultivation. The plan targets more than 10 flagship scenarios, more than 100 ecosystem companies, and enterprise revenue exceeding RMB 100 billion by 2028, building a nationally leading HarmonyOS agent innovation hub. On November 28, the 2026 Open-Source HarmonyOS Technology Conference was held in Nanjing; Huawei executive director and Terminal BG chairman Yu Chengdong said in a video address that open-source HarmonyOS has reached millions of households and empowered many industries, and that Huawei will continue supporting co-building and sharing of the technology and ecosystem, promoting large-scale adoption and helping partners seize digital transformation opportunities. Public data show Nanjing's software business revenue was about RMB 1.02 trillion in 2025, up 16.7% year on year, marking its first trillion-yuan industrial cluster. Nanjing has also issued a HarmonyOS ecosystem development action plan to become a national "HarmonyOS pioneer city"; 15 certified open-source HarmonyOS distribution operating systems and 122 software and hardware products currently rank second among Chinese cities.
items.why_zh: 该计划以地方政策形式为鸿蒙智能体设定明确的营收与生态目标，若如期推进，可能影响国内操作系统生态与AI智能体产业格局（推测）。
items.why_en: The plan sets concrete revenue and ecosystem targets for HarmonyOS agents through local policy, and if delivered on schedule it could shape China's OS ecosystem and AI agent industry landscape (speculation).

items.title_en: Shanghai HiSilicon Introduces Hi-OHOS Platform, Integrating NearLink, On-Device AI and Ultra-HD Audio/Video into OpenHarmony
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，2026 开源鸿蒙技术大会今日在南京举行。此次大会上，上海海思重点介绍了基于开源鸿蒙构建的统一 OS 平台 —— Hi-OHOS 。 官方表示，重构百亿 IoT 终端，需要一套系统原生的能力： 有联接 —— 分布式软总线结合星闪硬总线，兑现设备跨品牌跨品类互联互通； 有计算 ——AI 能力内建于系统框架，轻量终端也具备完整 AI 能力； 有感知 —— 系统级框架统一适配视觉、声学、IMU 等传感器件，感知数据即插即用，无需逐设备重复开发； 有交互 —— 从无屏到小屏再到大屏，分布式协同让交互界面随终端形态弹性伸缩。 而开源鸿蒙原生集成了联接、AI、图形等多项能力， 是千行百业轻智能升级的 OS 底座 。 据介绍，该平台将 星闪联接、端侧 AI、超高清音视频三大生态能力融入开源鸿蒙 ，通过芯片与操作系统的双向使能构筑核心竞争力，面向智慧家庭、消费电子、汽车电子三大产业场景，助力百亿量级 IoT 终端实现轻智能升级。 星闪“硬总线”与开源鸿蒙分布式“软总线”融合，形成软硬协同的互联互通底座； 端侧 NPU 推理、AI ISP 等能力下沉为系统级框架，让轻量终端原生具备 AI 运行环境； 超高清编解码、菁彩视听等音视频能力适配进系统媒体管线，让高品质视听体验直达终端。 ▲ 芯片能力注入 Hi-OHOS 平台能力
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that the 2026 OpenHarmony Technology Conference was held in Nanjing today, where Shanghai HiSilicon highlighted Hi-OHOS, a unified OS platform built on OpenHarmony. According to the company, rebuilding billions of IoT terminals requires system-native capabilities: connectivity—a distributed soft bus combined with the NearLink hard bus to deliver cross-brand, cross-category device interconnection; computing—AI capabilities built into the system framework so even lightweight terminals have full AI capability; perception—a system-level framework that uniformly adapts to vision, acoustic, IMU and other sensors, with perception data plug-and-play and no repeated per-device development; interaction—from screenless to small screens to large screens, distributed collaboration lets interaction interfaces scale elastically with terminal form factors. OpenHarmony natively integrates connectivity, AI, graphics and other capabilities and is described as the OS foundation for lightweight intelligence upgrades across industries. The platform integrates three ecosystem capabilities—NearLink connectivity, on-device AI and ultra-HD audio/video—into OpenHarmony, building core competitiveness through two-way enablement of chips and the operating system, targeting smart home, consumer electronics and automotive electronics to help billions of IoT terminals achieve lightweight intelligence upgrades: NearLink's 'hard bus' merges with OpenHarmony's distributed 'soft bus' to form a software-hardware connectivity foundation; on-device NPU inference, AI ISP and other capabilities are pushed down into system-level frameworks so lightweight terminals natively have an AI runtime environment; ultra-HD codecs, Audio Vivid and other audio/video capabilities are adapted into the system media pipeline so high-quality audiovisual experiences reach terminals directly.
items.why_zh: 为何重要（推测）：若该平台按介绍落地，可能推动开源鸿蒙 IoT 终端的 AI 与互联能力走向标准化；但目前内容为厂商自述，尚无第三方验证。
items.why_en: Why it matters (speculative): if the platform is deployed as described, it could help standardize AI and connectivity capabilities for OpenHarmony IoT terminals; however, the content is currently the vendor's own account and has not been independently verified.

items.title_zh: 俄罗斯 AI 模型续写果戈理《死魂灵》第二卷，读者反应不一
items.title_en: Russian AI Model Writes Continuation of Gogol's Dead Souls Volume II, Dividing Readers
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，1852 年，俄国作家尼古拉 · 果戈理因精神崩溃，将未完成的小说《死魂灵》部分手稿投入火中，几天之后，果戈理与世长辞。《死魂灵》至今仍被视为俄罗斯文学杰作，但果戈理始终没能完成全书。原计划中的三卷， 最终只有一卷完整留存 。 据路透社 27 日报道，由俄罗斯金融与科技集团 Sber 开发的 AI 模型 GigaChat，为被果戈理烧毁的第二卷 生成了一个续写版本 。这项大胆实验试图回答一个问题：人工智能能否真正捕捉伟大作家的创作风格与文学神韵？ 新书《死魂灵：复活》引起了部分读者的兴趣，却没有得到评论界的认可。这项实验汇集了语言学家、工程师和历史学家。项目负责人弗拉季斯拉夫 · 奥特罗申科透露，团队花了约四个月，才让 AI 形成一种“足以令人信服”的文学风格。 奥特罗申科接受路透社采访时对成果给予了肯定：“它在艺术表现方面做得相当出色，尤其是情节处理。这本书是畅销书…… 读者确实对它很感兴趣。它有没有艺术价值？当然有。这是同类实验中前所未有的首次尝试。更何况，我们挑战的是 俄罗斯文学中最难驾驭的风格之一：果戈理的文风与诗学 。” IT之家获悉，果戈理最为人熟知的，是其辛辣的讽刺笔法与黑色喜剧风格。《死魂灵》现存的第一卷塑造了一群形形色色的人物，主人公乞乞科夫便是其中最具代表性的一位。这个骗子打起了死去农奴的主意，企图收购那些虽然已经死亡、户籍上却仍登记在地主名下的农奴，以此实施一场金融骗局。 果戈理原本计划在第二、第三卷中描写乞乞科夫的道德转变，但他始终 无法摆脱创作困境与精神上的挣扎 ，最终没能完成这两部分。 参加 GigaChat 新书发布会的莫斯科居民伊戈尔对 AI 续写的成果颇为认可，认为它确实保留了原作的神韵。“这本书确实独一无二。我认为，果戈理的读者 终于有机会对它作出评价 ，与原作进行比较，看看乞乞科夫最后经历了怎样的冒险。” 不过，莫斯科果戈理博物馆的参观者拉丽莎并不买账。她直言，AI 不可能真正还原那些已经失传的文字。“这本书打动不了我，我甚至不想读。” 果戈理研究专家阿尔乔姆 · 尼基京则提出了另一层质疑：照这种逻辑，AI 岂不是可以给各种文学作品续写后续故事？ 但他也指出：“文学作品并不是作者此前创作内容的自动延伸。即使我们掌握了作者的 语言、风格和情节脉络 ，也无法据此推断他们接下来会 写出什么 。”
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: In 1852, Russian writer Nikolai Gogol, after a mental breakdown, threw part of the unfinished manuscript of Dead Souls into a fire and died a few days later; of the planned three volumes, only one survives complete. Reuters reported on Nov 27 that GigaChat, an AI model developed by Russian financial and technology group Sber, generated a continuation of the burned second volume, published as Dead Souls: Resurrection. The experiment brought together linguists, engineers and historians; project head Vladislav Otrashenko said the team spent about four months getting the AI to form a literary style 'convincing enough.' He praised the result's artistic performance, especially its plot handling, said the book is a bestseller and readers are genuinely interested, and argued it has artistic value as an unprecedented first attempt of its kind that took on one of the hardest styles in Russian literature. The report describes Gogol as known for sharp satire and black comedy; in the surviving first volume, Chichikov tries to buy dead serfs still registered to landowners to carry out a financial scam, and Gogol planned to depict Chichikov's moral transformation in volumes two and three but could not finish them. Moscow resident Igor, at the book launch, said the AI continuation preserved the original's spirit and that readers could finally evaluate it and compare it with the original; Gogol Museum visitor Larisa rejected it, saying AI cannot truly restore lost text and that the book 'doesn't move me; I don't even want to read it.' Gogol scholar Artem Nikitin questioned whether, by that logic, AI could continue any literary work, but also noted that literature is not an automatic extension of an author's previous writing; even with knowledge of language, style and plot, one cannot infer what the author would write next.
items.why_zh: 这凸显了AI能否捕捉文学风格与作者意图的争议；但这是一次实验性续写，并不能证明AI能真正还原失传文本。
items.why_en: This experiment highlights the debate over whether AI can capture literary style and authorial intent, but it is an experimental continuation and does not prove AI can truly restore lost texts.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，1852 年，俄国作家尼古拉 · 果戈理因精神崩溃，将未完成的小说《死魂灵》部分手稿投入火中，几天之后，果戈理与世长辞。《死魂灵》至今仍被视为俄罗斯文学杰作，但果戈理始终没能完成全书。原计划中的三卷， 最终只有一卷完整留存 。 据路透社 27 日报道，由俄罗斯金融与科技集团 Sber 开发的 AI 模型 GigaChat，为被果戈理烧毁的第二卷 生成了一个续写版本 。这项大胆实验试图回答一个问题：人工智能能否真正捕捉伟大作家的创作风格与文学神韵？ 新书《死魂灵：复活》引起了部分读者的兴趣，却没有得到评论界的认可。这项实验汇集了语言学家、工程师和历史学家。项目负责人弗拉季斯拉夫 · 奥特罗申科透露，团队花了约四个月，才让 AI 形成一种“足以令人信服”的文学风格。 奥特罗申科接受路透社采访时对成果给予了肯定：“它在艺术表现方面做得相当出色，尤其是情节处理。这本书是畅销书…… 读者确实对它很感兴趣。它有没有艺术价值？当然有。这是同类实验中前所未有的首次尝试。更何况，我们挑战的是 俄罗斯文学中最难驾驭的风格之一：果戈理的文风与诗学 。” IT之家获悉，果戈理最为人熟知的，是其辛辣的讽刺笔法与黑色喜剧风格。《死魂灵》现存的第一卷塑造了一群形形色色的人物，主人公乞乞科夫便是其中最具代表性的一位。这个骗子打起了死去农奴的主意，企图收购那些虽然已经死亡、户籍上却仍登记在地主名下的农奴，以此实施一场金融骗局。 果戈理原本计划在第二、第三卷中描写乞乞科夫的道德转变，但他始终 无法摆脱创作困境与精神上的挣扎 ，最终没能完成这两部分。 参加 GigaChat 新书发布会的莫斯科居民伊戈尔对 AI 续写的成果颇为认可，认为它确实保留了原作的神韵。“这本书确实独一无二。我认为，果戈理的读者 终于有机会对它作出评价 ，与原作进行比较，看看乞乞科夫最后经历了怎样的冒险。” 不过，莫斯科果戈理博物馆的参观者拉丽莎并不买账。她直言，AI 不可能真正还原那些已经失传的文字。“这本书打动不了我，我甚至不想读。” 果戈理研究专家阿尔乔姆 · 尼基京则提出了另一层质疑：照这种逻辑，AI 岂不是可以给各种文学作品续写后续故事？ 但他也指出：“文学作品并不是作者此前创作内容的自动延伸。即使我们掌握了作者的 语言、风格和情节脉络 ，也无法据此推断他们接下来会 写出什么 。”

items.title_en: 2027 Great Wall Tank 400 Family Launched: From RMB 249,800, Adds VLA Assisted-Driving Large Model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，长城汽车 2027 款坦克 400 家族今日在 2026 广州车展上正式上市，共推出 5 款车型，售价区间为 24.98 万至 31.98 万元。 新车提供汽油、柴油、Hi4-T 和 Hi4-Z 多种动力形式，主要升级集中在智能驾驶、座舱舒适性、内外饰配色及户外拓展配置等方面。其中，Hi4-Z 车型采用 800V 高压平台。 外观方面，新车延续现款机甲风格设计，新增钛空青车身配色，全系提供 4 种外观颜色。 车身长宽高分别为 4964×1970×1905 毫米，轴距为 2850 毫米。内饰新增旭辉橙配色，共提供两种内饰颜色，车内配备 15.6 英寸中控屏、12.3 英寸仪表屏，并搭载高通骁龙 8295 车机芯片。 座舱舒适性是本次升级的重点之一。新车对全车座椅进行加长、加厚处理，前排座椅按摩力度有所提升，后排新增座椅加热功能。 此外，新车还增加了流媒体内后视镜、远红外夜视系统 2.0、15.6 英寸 2.5K 后排娱乐屏、智能冷暖冰箱、隔音玻璃、ANC 主动降噪、后排隐私玻璃及遮阳帘等配置。需要注意的是，后排座椅仍未提供通风和按摩功能。 辅助驾驶方面，2027 款坦克 400 根据车型不同提供 Coffee Pilot 4 和 Coffee Pilot 2 系统。其中，高配车型搭载英伟达 Thor-U 芯片、192 线激光雷达及 4D 毫米波雷达，并引入 VLA Plus 辅助驾驶大模型，支持城市 NOA、高速 NOA 以及车位到车位领航辅助等功能。 户外拓展方面，新车在发动机舱盖两侧增加拓展点位，并在内后视镜和行李架位置预留 1/4 英寸螺纹孔，车内顶灯区域则升级为六路 AUX 电源开关，方便用户安装绞盘、射灯、车边帐等户外装备。 动力方面，汽油版车型搭载 2.0T 涡轮增压发动机 +48V 轻混动力系统，发动机最大功率 185kW，配备 9AT 变速箱；柴油版车型搭载 2.4T 柴油发动机，发动机最大功率 135kW，配备 9AT 变速箱。 Hi4-T 车型搭载 2.0T 涡轮增压发动机 + 单电机，发动机最大功率 185kW，电机最大功率 130kW，配备 37.1kWh 电池组，WLTC 纯电续航 105km，WLTC 综合续航 913km。 Hi4-Z 车型搭载 2.0T 涡轮增压发动机 + 双电机，发动机最大功率 180kW，电机最大功率 215kW（前）、240kW（后），配备 59.05kWh 电池组，WLTC 纯电续航 200km，WLTC 综合续航 1128km。 此外，长城汽车还透露，坦克 4.0T V8 发动机计划于 2027 年发布，同时将推出高性能 GF 系列，覆盖坦克全系车型。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: Great Wall Motor's 2027 Tank 400 family was launched at the 2026 Guangzhou auto show with five models priced from RMB 249,800 to RMB 319,800, offering gasoline, diesel, Hi4-T and Hi4-Z powertrains; upgrades focus on intelligent driving, cabin comfort, interior/exterior colors and outdoor-expansion features, and the Hi4-Z uses an 800V high-voltage platform. The vehicle keeps its mecha-style design, adds a Titanium Sky Cyan color, with four exterior colors across the lineup; dimensions are 4964×1970×1905 mm with a 2850 mm wheelbase; the interior adds Sunset Orange, for two interior colors, and features a 15.6-inch central screen, a 12.3-inch instrument screen and a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8295 chip. For the cabin, all seats are lengthened and thickened, front-seat massage intensity is increased, and rear seats add heating; new features include a streaming rearview mirror, far-infrared night vision system 2.0, a 15.6-inch 2.5K rear entertainment screen, a smart fridge, acoustic glass, ANC active noise cancellation, rear privacy glass and a sunshade; rear seats still lack ventilation and massage. For driver assistance, different models offer Coffee Pilot 4 and Coffee Pilot 2; the high trim has Nvidia Thor-U, a 192-line lidar and 4D millimeter-wave radar and introduces the VLA Plus assisted-driving large model, supporting city NOA, highway NOA and park-to-park navigation assistance. For outdoor expansion, expansion points are added on both sides of the hood, 1/4-inch threaded holes are reserved at the interior rearview mirror and roof rack, and the overhead light area is upgraded to six-channel AUX power switches. For powertrains, the gasoline version uses a 2.0T turbocharged engine with 48V mild hybrid, 185 kW maximum engine power and a 9AT; the diesel uses a 2.4T engine with 135 kW and a 9AT; Hi4-T uses a 2.0T engine plus a single motor, with 185 kW engine and 130 kW motor, a 37.1 kWh battery, 105 km WLTC electric range and 913 km WLTC combined range; Hi4-Z uses a 2.0T engine plus dual motors, with 180 kW engine, 215 kW front motor and 240 kW rear motor, a 59.05 kWh battery, 200 km WLTC electric range and 1128 km WLTC combined range. Great Wall also said a Tank 4.0T V8 engine is planned for 2027 and that a high-performance GF series covering the full Tank lineup will be launched.

items.title_zh: 英特尔 Gaudi2 加速卡逆袭：软件优化后部分 AI 性能超英伟达 H100
items.title_en: Intel Gaudi2 Beats Nvidia H100 in Some AI Inference After Software Optimization
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，Standard Kernel 公司于 11 月 18 日发布博文，通过优化英特尔 Gaudi2 加速器， 让其在特定 AI 推理任务中超过了英伟达 H100。 IT之家注：Gaudi2 是英特尔旗下 Habana Labs 研发的第二代深度学习加速器，于 2022 年 5 月发布，主要面向 AI 训练，相比较初代，制程从 16nm 升级到 7nm，TPC 数量从 8 个增至 24 个，并新增 FP8 支持。显存容量从 32GB 增至 96GB，片上 SRAM 翻倍至 48MB。 项目 Gaudi2 H100 PCIe 80GB 发布时间 2022 年 5 月 2022 年 10 月上市 制程 7nm 台积电 4N（定制 4nm 级） 计算单元 24 个 TPC，配双 MME 114 个 SM，456 个张量核心 显存 96GB HBM2E 80GB HBM2e 显存带宽 约 2.45TB/s 约 2TB/s BF16/FP16 算力（稠密） 约 432 TFLOPS（第三方数据） 约 756 TFLOPS（官方稀疏值的一半） FP8 算力（稠密） 约 865 TFLOPS（第三方数据，由 BF16 推算，英特尔官方未给出） 约 1,513 TFLOPS 功耗（TDP） 600W 350W 互连 24 个 100GbE RoCE 网口，合计 2.4Tb/s NVLink 桥接 600GB/s，PCIe Gen5 形态 OAM 模组，PCIe Gen4 x16 双槽风冷 PCIe 卡 租赁价格 约 0.60 美元 （现汇率约合 4 元人民币） / 小时 约 3.50 美元 （现汇率约合 23.3 元人民币） / 小时 测试对比了单块 Gaudi2 与单块 NVIDIA H100 80GB PCIe。测试模型为 Qwen3.5-27B-FP8，并发处理 16 个请求，每个请求输入 7 万个 token，共享前缀比例为 95%。这类负载接近编码智能体反复处理长对话历史或大型代码库的场景。 结果显示，在底层硬件不变的情况下，仅靠软件优化，Gaudi2 的缓存预填充吞吐量就提升 3.21 倍，达到每秒 5,409 个 token。其解码吞吐量提升 2.84 倍，达到每秒 475 个 token。 与 H100 相比，优化后的 Gaudi2 缓存预填充吞吐量高出 7.92%，解码吞吐量高出 60.35%。H100 的对应数据分别为每秒 5,012 个和 296 个 token。 在成本方面，Gaudi2 的租赁价格约为每小时 0.60 美元 （现汇率约合 4 元人民币） ，H100 约为 3.50 美元 （现汇率约合 23.3 元人民币） ，前者仅为后者的约 17%。按此计算，优化后的 Gaudi2 每美元解码的 token 数是 H100 的 9.4 倍，每美元新计算的缓存预填充 token 数是 H100 的 6.3 倍。解码每百万 token 的成本，Gaudi2 为 0.35 美元 （现汇率约合 2.3 元人民币） ，H100 为 3.28 美元 （现汇率约合 21.9 元人民币） 。 此次优化贯穿整个软件栈。预填充阶段改用更细的 128 个 token 分桶，减少填充造成的算力浪费，并把已缓存前缀与因果后缀分开处理，加快注意力计算。 团队还在 GDN 的中间张量上采用 FP16，同时让数值敏感的运算保持 FP32，以降低计算量和内存流量。解码阶段只需一次性收集共享的键值数据，并把卷积、激活、归一化等多项操作融合为单个 TPC 内核。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: Standard Kernel published a blog on Nov 18 saying that by optimizing Intel's Gaudi2 accelerator it surpassed Nvidia's H100 in certain AI inference tasks. Gaudi2 is the second-generation deep learning accelerator developed by Intel-owned Habana Labs, released in May 2022 and mainly aimed at AI training; compared with the first generation, its process moved from 16nm to 7nm, TPC count rose from 8 to 24, FP8 support was added, memory increased from 32GB to 96GB and on-chip SRAM doubled to 48MB. The test compared one Gaudi2 with one Nvidia H100 80GB PCIe using Qwen3.5-27B-FP8, 16 concurrent requests, 70,000 input tokens per request and a 95% shared-prefix ratio. Results showed that with unchanged underlying hardware and only software optimization, Gaudi2's cached prefill throughput rose 3.21x to 5,409 tokens/s and decode throughput rose 2.84x to 475 tokens/s; compared with H100, optimized Gaudi2's cached prefill throughput was 7.92% higher and decode throughput 60.35% higher, while H100's corresponding figures were 5,012 and 296 tokens/s. On cost, Gaudi2 rental was about $0.60/hour versus about $3.50/hour for H100, about 17% of the latter; on that basis, optimized Gaudi2 delivered 9.4x H100's decode tokens per dollar and 6.3x its cached-prefill tokens per dollar; decode cost per million tokens was $0.35 for Gaudi2 and $3.28 for H100. The optimization spanned the software stack: in prefill it used finer 128-token buckets to reduce wasted compute from padding and processed cached prefixes and causal suffixes separately; it used FP16 for GDN intermediate tensors while keeping numerically sensitive operations in FP32; in decode it collected shared key-value data once and fused convolution, activation and normalization into a single TPC kernel.
items.why_zh: 若结果可复现，这可能显示软件优化和较低租赁成本能让非英伟达加速器在特定长上下文推理负载中具备竞争力；但该结果来自一家公司的单次测试和单一模型，仍需独立验证。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，Standard Kernel 公司于 11 月 18 日发布博文，通过优化英特尔 Gaudi2 加速器， 让其在特定 AI 推理任务中超过了英伟达 H100。 IT之家注：Gaudi2 是英特尔旗下 Habana Labs 研发的第二代深度学习加速器，于 2022 年 5 月发布，主要面向 AI 训练，相比较初代，制程从 16nm 升级到 7nm，TPC 数量从 8 个增至 24 个，并新增 FP8 支持。显存容量从 32GB 增至 96GB，片上 SRAM 翻倍至 48MB。 项目 Gaudi2 H100 PCIe 80GB 发布时间 2022 年 5 月 2022 年 10 月上市 制程 7nm 台积电 4N（定制 4nm 级） 计算单元 24 个 TPC，配双 MME 114 个 SM，456 个张量核心 显存 96GB HBM2E 80GB HBM2e 显存带宽 约 2.45TB/s 约 2TB/s BF16/FP16 算力（稠密） 约 432 TFLOPS（第三方数据） 约 756 TFLOPS（官方稀疏值的一半） FP8 算力（稠密） 约 865 TFLOPS（第三方数据，由 BF16 推算，英特尔官方未给出） 约 1,513 TFLOPS 功耗（TDP） 600W 350W 互连 24 个 100GbE RoCE 网口，合计 2.4Tb/s NVLink 桥接 600GB/s，PCIe Gen5 形态 OAM 模组，PCIe Gen4 x16 双槽风冷 PCIe 卡 租赁价格 约 0.60 美元 （现汇率约合 4 元人民币） / 小时 约 3.50 美元 （现汇率约合 23.3 元人民币） / 小时 测试对比了单块 Gaudi2 与单块 NVIDIA H100 80GB PCIe。测试模型为 Qwen3.5-27B-FP8，并发处理 16 个请求，每个请求输入 7 万个 token，共享前缀比例为 95%。这类负载接近编码智能体反复处理长对话历史或大型代码库的场景。 结果显示，在底层硬件不变的情况下，仅靠软件优化，Gaudi2 的缓存预填充吞吐量就提升 3.21 倍，达到每秒 5,409 个 token。其解码吞吐量提升 2.84 倍，达到每秒 475 个 token。 与 H100 相比，优化后的 Gaudi2 缓存预填充吞吐量高出 7.92%，解码吞吐量高出 60.35%。H100 的对应数据分别为每秒 5,012 个和 296 个 token。 在成本方面，Gaudi2 的租赁价格约为每小时 0.60 美元 （现汇率约合 4 元人民币） ，H100 约为 3.50 美元 （现汇率约合 23.3 元人民币） ，前者仅为后者的约 17%。按此计算，优化后的 Gaudi2 每美元解码的 token 数是 H100 的 9.4 倍，每美元新计算的缓存预填充 token 数是 H100 的 6.3 倍。解码每百万 token 的成本，Gaudi2 为 0.35 美元 （现汇率约合 2.3 元人民币） ，H100 为 3.28 美元 （现汇率约合 21.9 元人民币） 。 此次优化贯穿整个软件栈。预填充阶段改用更细的 128 个 token 分桶，减少填充造成的算力浪费，并把已缓存前缀与因果后缀分开处理，加快注意力计算。 团队还在 GDN 的中间张量上采用 FP16，同时让数值敏感的运算保持 FP32，以降低计算量和内存流量。解码阶段只需一次性收集共享的键值数据，并把卷积、激活、归一化等多项操作融合为单个 TPC 内核。

items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: China's National Radio and Television Administration (NRTA) on that day notified typical cases in a special governance campaign against harmful dissemination of online audiovisual programs, with platforms including Kuaishou, Douyin, iQIYI, Baidu Netdisk, Weibo, Bilibili, Hongguo Short Drama, WeChat and Tencent on the disposal list. The notice said that since the beginning of this year the NRTA has conducted special governance of the harmful dissemination ecology in online dramas, micro-dramas and online variety shows, rectifying piracy, vulgar/harmful, violent/terrorist and AI-tampered content. The cases fall into three categories: first, handling piracy dissemination, including Kuaishou, Douyin, iQIYI and Dianzhong disposing of violating accounts or removing pirated comic dramas; Baidu Netdisk, Xunlei Cloud, Weibo, 360, Quark Search and Wukong Browser handling pirated links on net disks, browsers and search engines; and NetEase and Ximalaya handling comments that spread or sell pirated resources. Second, handling illegal micro-dramas and their producers/disseminators: Hongguo, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Baidu and Dianzhong intercepted and handled vulgar/harmful micro-dramas; Hongguo imposed deadline rectification on production agencies; WeChat, Bilibili, Douyin and Weibo handled mini-programs or accounts spreading illegal micro-dramas. Third, handling violent/terrorist, vulgar/harmful, wrongly oriented, AI-tampered and minor-protection-violating content: iQIYI, Bilibili, Youku, Xiaohongshu and Tencent were named; Tencent was cited for handling content that AI-tampered with classics such as Romance of the Three Kingdoms and Water Margin, historical figures and animation images familiar to minors, and Xiaohongshu and iQIYI handled short videos AI-tampering Dream of the Red Chamber. The notice also said that this year 75,000 illegal micro-dramas had been removed and more than 1,500 violating accounts handled; a new round of special governance on vulgarization and homogenization of micro-dramas from Nov 1 to end-December is ongoing, focusing on AI abuse such as 'face stealing' and 'voice stealing' and homogenized homepage/first-screen recommendations. The NRTA said it will continue to intensify rectification and further press platforms to fulfill their primary responsibilities.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，科技媒体 Tom's Hardware 昨日（11 月 27 日）发布博文，报道称名叫埃利奥特 · 卡伦德（Elliot Callender）的抗议者， 目前已在 Anthropic 旧金山总部外绝食 4 天，要求叫停 AI 递归式自我改进。 IT之家注：AI 递归式自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement，简称 RSI）是指 AI 系统具备改进自己的能力，比如改写代码、优化训练方法、设计更强的下一代模型。改进后的系统再继续改进自己，这样一轮轮循环下去。 卡伦德表示哪怕要绝食超过 40 天，只要能施压 Anthropic 给其造成负面影响，我也在所不惜。他还透露，结束对 Anthropic 的抗议后，下一个目标将是 OpenAI。他同时呼吁加州居民致电州长加文 · 纽森，请求召开立法会议，专门讨论递归式自我改进（RSI）问题。 报道指出，人工智能行业的快速发展持续引发社会各界反对，抗议活动已屡见不鲜。11 月 19 日是 Anthropic 上市当天， 多地同时爆发抗议 。有外媒报道称，旧金山警方曾在该公司总部外逮捕多名抗议者。 相关阅读： 《 Anthropic 上市当天，离职研究员考克森在其总部外呼吁禁止 AI 递归自我改进 》 《 Anthropic 工程师警告：AI 越准人类越容易丧失独立思考能力，越依赖越难保持警惕 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: Tom's Hardware reported on Nov 27 that protester Elliot Callender has been fasting for four days outside Anthropic's San Francisco headquarters, demanding a halt to AI recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI refers to an AI system's ability to improve itself, such as by rewriting code, optimizing training methods or designing a stronger next-generation model, with the improved system then continuing to improve itself in a loop. Callender said he would fast for more than 40 days if necessary as long as it pressures Anthropic and causes it negative impact; he also said that after ending the protest against Anthropic, his next target will be OpenAI, and called on California residents to phone Governor Gavin Newsom to request a legislative session specifically on RSI. The report noted that the rapid development of the AI industry has continued to draw opposition from various sectors and protests are common; on Nov 19, the day Anthropic listed, protests broke out in multiple places at the same time, and foreign media reported that San Francisco police had arrested several protesters outside the company's headquarters. Related reading also mentioned that on Anthropic's listing day, former researcher Coxon called outside its headquarters for a ban on AI recursive self-improvement; an Anthropic engineer warned that the more accurate AI becomes, the easier it is for humans to lose independent thinking, and the more dependent they become, the harder it is to stay alert.
items.why_zh: 这反映围绕AI递归式自我改进的民间担忧在上升；但这是一次活动人士抗议，本身并不代表政策已改变。
items.why_en: The action reflects growing civil-society concern about recursive self-improvement, but it is an activist protest and does not by itself indicate a policy change.

items.title_zh: Galaxy S27 系列手机专享，三星 One UI 9.5 Beta 曝光 36 项 AI 新功能
items.title_en: Samsung One UI 9.5 Beta Reportedly Reveals 36 AI Features Exclusive to Galaxy S27 Series
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，科技媒体 Android Authority 昨日（11 月 27 日）发布博文， 通过挖掘 One UI 9.5 首个 Beta 测试版代码，发现了关联“20271”的 36 项 Galaxy AI 功能，预估将成为 Galaxy S27 系列手机独占 AI 功能。 根据三星内部代码细节，三星 Galaxy S26 Ultra 的 Galaxy AI 内部版本号为“20263”，暂不满足运行上述 AI 功能的要求，但不排除在 Galaxy S27 系列发布后，将这些功能下放到 S26 系列的可能。 IT之家援引博文介绍，附上文中相关主要功能介绍如下： 图库与照片编辑 重新构图：用 AI 改变照片的拍摄角度，事后调整构图。 短视频：把静态照片转成短视频。 照片辅助提示建议：编辑时给出 AI 提示。 Restyle 风格包：新增照片风格。 生成贴纸按钮：直接生成贴纸。 相机与扫描 ProScan：支持页面展平和双页书籍扫描，适合拍书和文档。 专业模式监视器视图：给专业拍摄提供辅助画面。 拍摄建议：加入动态取景框。 Log 视频 LUT：新增“森林”和“水下”两款色彩预设。 选择、通话与安全 AI 选择：识别完整表格，可一键复制。 虚假来电检测：识别可疑来电。 第三方应用通话录音与诈骗检测：扩大适用范围。 谷歌诈骗检测：扩展到更多语言。 通话音频擦除：通话中去除不需要的声音。 输入与录音 键盘语音输入优化：提升语音转文字的效果。 录音机说话人分离：能区分重叠说话的人。 付费与版本限制 Gen Video 积分、三星浏览器“问任何问题”、Now Brief 的 Bixby 操作卡片：似乎与付费的 Galaxy AI Premium 层级相关。 Zoom enhancer、三星私有 AI 云 SPAC、Memory 应用：暂未发现版本限制。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: Android Authority reported on Nov 27 that by examining code in the first One UI 9.5 beta, it found 36 Galaxy AI features linked to '20271,' expected to be exclusive to the Galaxy S27 series. Internal code shows the Galaxy S26 Ultra's Galaxy AI internal version is '20263' and does not currently meet the requirements to run those features, though a rollout to the S26 series after the S27 launch is not ruled out. The listed features include: in gallery and photo editing, recomposition, turning still photos into short videos, photo-assist prompt suggestions, a Restyle style pack and a generate-sticker button; in camera and scanning, ProScan page flattening and two-page book scanning, a pro-mode monitor view, shooting suggestions with a dynamic viewfinder, and 'forest' and 'underwater' LUTs for Log video; in selection, calls and security, AI selection that recognizes complete tables for one-click copying, fake-call detection, expanded third-party app call recording and scam detection, Google scam detection in more languages, and call audio erasure; in input and recording, optimized keyboard voice input and recorder speaker separation; Gen Video credits, Samsung Browser's 'Ask anything' and Now Brief's Bixby action cards appear related to a paid Galaxy AI Premium tier; no version limits were found for Zoom enhancer, Samsung's private AI cloud SPAC or the Memory app.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这意味着三星可能把新一代Galaxy AI功能作为S27系列的独占卖点；但该信息来自Beta代码挖掘，尚未获三星官方确认。
items.why_en: If accurate, this suggests Samsung may use the new Galaxy AI features as an exclusive selling point for the Galaxy S27 series; the claim comes from beta code analysis and has not been officially confirmed by Samsung.

items.title_zh: iOS 27.3 前瞻苹果 AI 限额：Siri AI 标准每日 20 次云端请求
items.title_en: iOS 27.3 Preview of Apple AI Limits: Siri AI Standard Quota of 20 Cloud Requests per Day
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，技术博主 @itspdfu 于 11 月 26 日在 X 平台发布长推文， 通过挖掘 iOS 27.3 Beta 2 开发者预览版，发现了苹果 Siri AI 和多项 Apple Intelligence 功能的每日使用限额。 消息源指出根据苹果设定， 设备每向苹果的私密云计算（PCC）发起一次请求，就消耗一个 Token。 而这些 Token 只用来证明用户还有可用额度，不会暴露用户身份。 在请求流程中，用户在 iPhone 端发起的云端 PCC 请求，会先联系 Token 授予服务（Token Granting Service，简称 TGS）。TGS 知道用户是谁，会核查用户的使用资格和剩余额度，但不知道用户具体问了什么。 核查通过后，TGS 向设备返回一批一次性 Token（One-Time Tokens，OTT），设备把这些 Token 存在本地。随着用户使用，设备再继续申请新的 Token。对于受计量的功能，设备通常每批申请 5 个 Token。 IT之家注：这里的 Token 是私密云计算（PCC）的访问令牌，并非 AI 模型中的词元（Token），设备每向苹果的私密云计算发起一次请求，就消耗一个 Token。一次 Siri AI 查询可能多次连接 PCC，比如查找附近营业的书店，就消耗了 2 个 Token。复杂任务一次可能扣 2 到 3 个。 在 OS 27.3 Beta 2 中，Siri AI 每台设备每天的标准额度是 20 个 Token。订阅 2TB 的 iCloud+ 套餐后，可在此基础上再增加 80 个，每天共 100 个，相当于标准额度的 5 倍。 IT之家此前报道， iCloud+ 现有订阅方案将提供不同等级的 AI 使用额度提升， 订阅价格暂时不会调整： 50GB（免费）：不增加 AI 使用额度。 200GB：最高提升至免费额度的 2 倍，月费 2.99 美元 （现汇率约合 20 元人民币） 。 2TB：最高提升至 5 倍，月费 9.99 美元 （现汇率约合 66.7 元人民币） 。 6TB：最高提升至 10 倍，月费 29.99 美元 （现汇率约合 200.3 元人民币） 。 12TB：最高提升至 20 倍，月费 59.99 美元 （现汇率约合 400.6 元人民币） 。 图乐园和照片生成式编辑的标准额度为每天 10 个，2TB 套餐用户可用到 50 个。快捷指令中的云端模型，以及第三方应用调用苹果基础模型，标准额度都是每天 5 个，2TB 套餐用户可用到 25 个。 额度分为设备、账户和家庭三个池子，使用时会优先扣除设备额度。Token 缓存在申请它的那台设备上，不能在设备之间通用。所以一台设备的额度用完后，另一台设备仍有可能继续发起请求。 此外一次 Siri AI 查询可能会多次连接 PCC。比如查找附近营业的书店，一次就消耗了 2 个 Token。苹果还计划推出按成本计量的“退款”机制，让简单请求少扣一些额度。不过这一机制目前尚未生效。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 28 that tech blogger @itspdfu said on X on Nov 26 that, by digging into the iOS 27.3 Beta 2 developer preview, they found daily usage limits for Siri AI and multiple Apple Intelligence features. The source said each request a device makes to Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC) consumes one Token, and these Tokens only prove the user still has available quota and do not reveal identity. In the request flow, the device first contacts the Token Granting Service (TGS), which checks the user's eligibility and remaining quota and returns one-time Tokens (OTT); the device stores them locally and requests more as needed, with metered features usually requesting 5 Tokens per batch. Here Token means a PCC access token, not an AI model token; one Siri AI query may connect to PCC multiple times, for example finding a nearby open bookstore consumes 2 Tokens, and a complex task may deduct 2 to 3. In OS 27.3 Beta 2, the standard Siri AI quota is 20 Tokens per device per day; subscribing to 2TB iCloud+ adds 80, for 100 per day total, 5 times the standard quota. In iCloud+ plans, 50GB free adds no quota, 200GB up to 2 times ($2.99/month), 2TB up to 5 times ($9.99), 6TB up to 10 times ($29.99), and 12TB up to 20 times ($59.99). Image Playground and Photos generative editing have a standard quota of 10 per day, and 2TB subscribers can use 50; the cloud model in Shortcuts and third-party apps calling Apple foundation models have a standard quota of 5 per day, and 2TB subscribers can use 25. Quotas are divided into device, account and family pools, with device quota deducted first; Tokens are cached on the device that requested them and cannot be used across devices. Apple also plans a cost-based refund mechanism to deduct less for simple requests, but it is not yet active.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该测试设定最终落地，可能表明苹果正用分级 iCloud+ 订阅区分 Apple Intelligence 云端使用额度。
items.why_en: Speculation: if this tested setup is eventually launched, it may indicate that Apple is using tiered iCloud+ subscriptions to differentiate Apple Intelligence cloud usage quotas.

items.summary_zh: “IT早报”时间，大家好，现在是 2026 年 11 月 28 日星期六，今天的重要科技资讯有： 1. items.summary_en: IT Morning Brief for Saturday, Nov 28, 2026, includes: 1) DeepSeek is testing in a small mobile rollout a display of quota consumed in the current round, showing Token consumption and estimated cost per conversation, while individual users can still use the service for free; 2) two NRTA rules took effect on Nov 27, fully banning startup ads on cable TV and IPTV, with violations fined up to RMB 100,000; more than 600 million users can watch live TV at startup, while smart TV makers' startup ads are temporarily unaffected; 3) BYD Ocean Network's first flagship MPV, Haijing, made its global debut, positioned for the family flagship MPV market; 4) SAMR on Nov 27 summoned 15 electric bicycle companies including Yadea, Tailg and Aima; 5) reports said Hikvision canceled the alternating big/small week schedule for two-day weekends but removed breakfast and dinner subsidies, with employees saying they lose RMB 3,000 per month; Hikvision said the report about canceling the schedule facing employee resistance is untrue and opposes ineffective involution that replaces value contribution with time at work; 6) Audi Q9 made its China debut at the Guangzhou auto show, the brand's largest SUV and first to use the '9' naming; 7) China's independent fusion energy solution released an initial engineering plan, to be implemented in two stages, first fusion ignition and core process validation, then a demonstration reactor; 8) Meituan CEO Wang Xing discussed an inflection point in food delivery, saying average order value rebounded notably year on year and subsidies are becoming more rational; Meituan Q3 revenue was RMB 115.6 billion and net profit turned positive; 9) ByteDance Volcano Engine said the Doubao large model already serves 80% of leading domestic TV makers, with Skyworth, Changhong, Hisense and TCL launching mass-produced TVs, and Doubao-model TVs surpassing RMB 100 million in Douyin e-commerce sales during Double 11; 10) BMW plans a new round of voluntary employee departure compensation, after some employees received EUR 650,000 in the first round; 11) GAC's Yang Long said Aion's C-end sales share this year has reached 81%; 12) GAC Toyota Highlander 9X was announced as Toyota's first extended-range model and the world's first extended-range Highlander, with Huawei and CATL; 13) Lynk 900L opened presale as a 900V flagship large seven-seat SUV, priced RMB 329,800-389,800, with early delivery price RMB 309,800-369,800; 14) Leapmotor's new Lafa5 launched at a limited-time price of RMB 102,800-128,800 with full-domain 800V.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 转守为攻：反诉苹果窃密，喊话“不公平竞争”
items.title_en: OpenAI Goes on the Offensive: Counter-Sues Apple for Alleged Trade Secret Theft, Alleges 'Unfair Competition'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，《金融时报》昨日（11 月 27 日）发布博文，报道称在苹果公司提起的商业秘密诉讼中，OpenAI 公司已经提出反诉，指控苹果自身窃取了 OpenAI 的商业秘密，并涉嫌胁迫和威胁同时为两家公司供货的供应商。 苹果公司于 2026 年 7 月起诉 OpenAI，称前员工 Tang Tan 和 Chang Liu 离职后，将商业秘密带到了 OpenAI。 OpenAI 在反诉中称，一名员工曾从苹果跳槽至 OpenAI，工作六个月后又返回苹果，并通过个人账户带回了一款 OpenAI 硬件设备的详细资料。这些资料据称包括图片、工程信息、供应商详情、制造数据，以及外观涂层和密封剂标准。该说法早在 10 月就已在法院文件中披露。 在反竞争方面，OpenAI 指责苹果利用规模优势阻碍对手，在 OpenAI 筹备发售 AI 设备之际，“胁迫和威胁”现有及潜在供应商，并称这是“不择手段地进行不公平竞争”，涉及多种非法、不公平和侵权行为。 此外，OpenAI 认为苹果起诉的真实目的是阻止员工被挖走，并称苹果曾鼓励员工把公司文件存放在个人设备和云存储账户中，让员工陷入“加州旅馆”式的陷阱。 IT之家注：“加州旅馆”式的陷阱，指的是一种只进不出、一旦进入就很难脱身的处境。这个说法来自老鹰乐队（Eagles）的名曲《Hotel California》。歌里有一句大意是：你随时可以退房，却永远无法离开。这句歌词常被用来比喻这类困境。 在这起反诉官司中，OpenAI 主张认为苹果鼓励员工把公司文件存放在个人设备和云存储账户中。员工一旦这样做，就会被卷入“带走机密”的嫌疑，离职后也难以洗清。OpenAI 因此认为，苹果起诉的真实目的不是真心保护商业机密，更大的目的是阻止员工被挖走。 相关阅读： 《 苹果诉 OpenAI 案新进展：法官允许苹果扩大取证范围 》 《 苹果与 OpenAI 商业秘密诉讼交锋升级：互指违规提交新证据 》 《 苹果诉 OpenAI 窃取商业秘密案新进展：法院准许苹果调取后者招聘材料 》 《 双方关系何时破裂？OpenAI 称与苹果的 ChatGPT 合作远不及预期 》 《 美国联邦法官驳回 OpenAI 请求，苹果无需公布与 SpaceXAI 和解协议 》
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 28 that the Financial Times published an article on Nov 27 saying that in Apple's trade secret lawsuit, OpenAI has filed a counterclaim accusing Apple itself of stealing OpenAI trade secrets and of coercing and threatening suppliers that serve both companies. Apple sued OpenAI in July 2026, alleging former employees Tang Tan and Chang Liu took trade secrets to OpenAI after leaving. In its counterclaim, OpenAI said an employee jumped from Apple to OpenAI, returned to Apple after six months, and brought back detailed information about an OpenAI hardware device through a personal account, allegedly including images, engineering information, supplier details, manufacturing data, and coating and sealant specifications; the claim was disclosed in court filings as early as October. OpenAI also accused Apple of using its scale to hinder rivals and of coercing and threatening existing and potential suppliers as OpenAI prepares to launch an AI device, calling this unfair competition by any means and involving various illegal, unfair and infringing acts. OpenAI argued that Apple's real purpose in suing is to stop employees from being poached, and said Apple encouraged employees to store company files on personal devices and cloud storage accounts, trapping employees in a 'Hotel California' situation.
items.why_zh: 推测：若反诉进入实体审理，可能进一步揭示苹果与 OpenAI 在 AI 硬件、人才和供应链竞争中的法律冲突。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，《金融时报》昨日（11 月 27 日）发布博文，报道称在苹果公司提起的商业秘密诉讼中，OpenAI 公司已经提出反诉，指控苹果自身窃取了 OpenAI 的商业秘密，并涉嫌胁迫和威胁同时为两家公司供货的供应商。 苹果公司于 2026 年 7 月起诉 OpenAI，称前员工 Tang Tan 和 Chang Liu 离职后，将商业秘密带到了 OpenAI。 OpenAI 在反诉中称，一名员工曾从苹果跳槽至 OpenAI，工作六个月后又返回苹果，并通过个人账户带回了一款 OpenAI 硬件设备的详细资料。这些资料据称包括图片、工程信息、供应商详情、制造数据，以及外观涂层和密封剂标准。该说法早在 10 月就已在法院文件中披露。 在反竞争方面，OpenAI 指责苹果利用规模优势阻碍对手，在 OpenAI 筹备发售 AI 设备之际，“胁迫和威胁”现有及潜在供应商，并称这是“不择手段地进行不公平竞争”，涉及多种非法、不公平和侵权行为。 此外，OpenAI 认为苹果起诉的真实目的是阻止员工被挖走，并称苹果曾鼓励员工把公司文件存放在个人设备和云存储账户中，让员工陷入“加州旅馆”式的陷阱。 IT之家注：“加州旅馆”式的陷阱，指的是一种只进不出、一旦进入就很难脱身的处境。这个说法来自老鹰乐队（Eagles）的名曲《Hotel California》。歌里有一句大意是：你随时可以退房，却永远无法离开。这句歌词常被用来比喻这类困境。 在这起反诉官司中，OpenAI 主张认为苹果鼓励员工把公司文件存放在个人设备和云存储账户中。员工一旦这样做，就会被卷入“带走机密”的嫌疑，离职后也难以洗清。OpenAI 因此认为，苹果起诉的真实目的不是真心保护商业机密，更大的目的是阻止员工被挖走。 相关阅读： 《 苹果诉 OpenAI 案新进展：法官允许苹果扩大取证范围 》 《 苹果与 OpenAI 商业秘密诉讼交锋升级：互指违规提交新证据 》 《 苹果诉 OpenAI 窃取商业秘密案新进展：法院准许苹果调取后者招聘材料 》 《 双方关系何时破裂？OpenAI 称与苹果的 ChatGPT 合作远不及预期 》 《 美国联邦法官驳回 OpenAI 请求，苹果无需公布与 SpaceXAI 和解协议 》

items.title_en: RoboOH 2.0, the first embodied-AI operating system built by the OpenHarmony community, officially released
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，2026 开源鸿蒙技术大会在南京举行。大会期间， 开源鸿蒙具身智能操作系统 RoboOH 2.0 Release 版本正式发布 。 该系统通过 RoboMaestro 系统级运行底座与 RoboFrame 本体抽象层两大核心组件，构建兼容多种技术路线、支持不同机器人本体的开放系统架构，为国产具身智能产业提供了一套自主可控、生态开放的系统级底座。 RoboOH 2.0 支持多模型推理、数据采集及机器人运动控制等能力， 覆盖双足、四足、轮式及旋翼等不同形态 。 IT之家了解到，大会还发布了开源鸿蒙设备平台 1.0 Release 及开源鸿蒙统一互联 3.0 Release。 前者支持 AI 辅助应用开发及芯片适配，可面向两轮车、家电等设备；后者拓展了跨厂商设备互联等能力 。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家, the 2026 OpenHarmony Technology Conference was held in Nanjing, where the OpenHarmony embodied-AI operating system RoboOH 2.0 Release was officially launched. Through two core components — the RoboMaestro system-level runtime base and the RoboFrame body abstraction layer — the system builds an open architecture compatible with multiple technical routes and supporting different robot bodies, providing China's embodied-AI industry with an independent, controllable and open system-level foundation. RoboOH 2.0 supports capabilities including multi-model inference, data collection and robot motion control, covering bipedal, quadrupedal, wheeled and rotor-based forms. The conference also released OpenHarmony Device Platform 1.0 Release (supporting AI-assisted application development and chip adaptation, targeting devices such as two-wheelers and home appliances) and OpenHarmony Unified Connectivity 3.0 Release (expanding capabilities such as cross-vendor device interconnection).
items.why_zh: 推测：若该操作系统被产业采用，将为国产机器人提供自主可控的系统级底座，降低对海外机器人软件栈的依赖。
items.why_en: Speculation: if adopted by industry, the OS could give domestic robotics an independent, controllable system-level foundation and reduce reliance on foreign robot software stacks.

items.title_en: Edge Browser Will Not Add New AI to Right-Click Menu; Microsoft Apologizes for Possible Inconvenience from Shelving the Plan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，科技媒体 NeoWin 昨日（11 月 27 日）发布博文，报道称微软已搁置为 Edge 浏览器扩展 AI 功能计划， 不再为该浏览器右键菜单加入摘要、引用和翻译功能。 IT之家援引博文介绍，微软于 2025 年 6 月更新 AI at Work 路线图条目 RM497135，规划在 Microsoft Edge 浏览器中，为右键菜单添加 3 项 AI 选项，用户选中文本后右键，可以调用 Copilot 完成摘要、引用和翻译功能。 不过微软近期更新该条目，表示“ 我们已决定取消这项计划发布。由此可能造成的不便，我们深表歉意。 ”微软没有说明取消的具体原因。 该媒体指出相关能力仍可通过其他入口使用，用户选中网页文字后右键点击“发送到 Copilot”，右侧会打开聊天界面，所选文本已自动带入。用户随后可要求 Copilot 总结、翻译或生成引用，测试中均顺利完成，结果也较为准确。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 28 that tech outlet NeoWin published an article on Nov 27 saying Microsoft has shelved plans to expand AI features in the Edge browser right-click menu and will no longer add summarize, quote and translate functions there. In June 2025, Microsoft updated AI at Work roadmap item RM497135 to plan three AI options in the Edge right-click menu, letting users select text and right-click to invoke Copilot for summarizing, quoting and translation. Microsoft recently updated the item saying it has decided to cancel the planned release and deeply apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause, without explaining the specific reason. The outlet noted that the capabilities remain available through other entry points: after selecting web text, users can right-click 'Send to Copilot', opening a chat pane on the right with the selected text automatically included; users can then ask Copilot to summarize, translate or generate a quote, which worked smoothly and produced fairly accurate results in tests.
items.why_zh: 推测：这表明微软可能正在收回 Edge 右键菜单中的新增 AI 入口，转而依赖 Copilot 侧边栏等更统一的入口。
items.why_en: Speculation: this suggests Microsoft may be pulling back from adding new AI options in the Edge right-click menu and relying instead on more unified entry points such as the Copilot sidebar.

items.title_zh: 防考生利用 AI 作弊，韩国学校抢购金属探测器
items.title_en: South Korean schools rush to buy metal detectors to prevent AI-assisted exam cheating
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，据央视新闻报道，为防范考生利用人工智能（AI）设备作弊，韩国教育部近日发布新规，要求所有参加校内考试的学生须在考试前后 接受金属探测器检查 。各地学校加紧采购金属探测器，导致供不应求。 报道提到，一家生产便携式金属探测器的韩国厂商 27 日表示，客户咨询数量较往常增加了约 100 倍，公司大幅提升产量，仍难以满足需求。另一厂商说，如果现在订购，需等待约半个月才能拿到货。一家线上商家也发布公告说，现货已售罄，预计下月初才会补货，目前只接受预订。 在买不到金属探测器的情况下，不少学校转而选择租用设备应急， 租赁公司接到的咨询量显著增多 。一家金属探测器租赁公司的负责人表示，过去一般是有安保要求的活动需要租用金属探测器，租给学校监考还是头一次。 据韩国方面消息，韩国 2027 学年大学录取名额中，超过 80% 将通过提前选拔录取，高中成绩在其中起着关键作用。然而， 常有考生借助微型摄像头等高科技设备实施作弊 ，相关设备藏匿于衣物或随身物品中，难以发现。因此，韩国教育部要求各地学校在校内考试中使用金属探测器；而对于设备不足的学校，韩国教育部将协助其向警察部门等公共机构借用，或与附近学校共享。 IT之家注意到，韩国教育部 27 日公布的数据显示，截至 11 月 25 日，在 2027 学年度大学修学能力考试（高考）中已查处作弊行为 474 起，较去年同期的 279 起增加 69.9%。其中， 涉及智能设备的作弊行为达到 112 起 ，是去年的 3.6 倍，接近全部作弊案例的四分之一。 针对利用智能设备实施的严重作弊行为，教育部已于本月 23 日对 6 名考生提出刑事控告。为防止类似事件再次发生，教育部计划今后加强检查，从源头上阻止可能用于作弊的物品被带入考场。 此外，教育部还将把高考和校内考试的监管标准扩大至其主管的 6 类国家级考试，并提高作弊处罚力度。 据IT之家此前报道，韩国政府为查获考场内未上交的手机，向高考考生与普通民众同步发送了紧急灾难通知短信。短信发送后， 处于开机状态的手机将鸣响 10.5 秒警报 。 相关阅读： 《 韩国高考已查处涉智能设备作弊达 112 起，增至去年 3.6 倍 》 《 韩国防 AI 作弊新招：要求考生穿围裙考试、时隔 6 年重新收缴手机 》 《 韩国高考 AI 作弊事件发酵，教育部长引咎辞职 》 《 韩国教育部认定今年高考共 111 起涉电子设备作弊：利用智能手机拍考卷等 》 《 韩国首次利用紧急灾难通知“0 级短信”打击 AI 辅助作弊行为，成功在高考中抓获 54 名违规考生 》
items.summary_en: IT之家, November 27: according to CCTV News, to prevent test-takers from cheating with artificial intelligence (AI) devices, South Korea's Ministry of Education recently issued new rules requiring all students taking in-school exams to undergo metal detector checks before and after exams, prompting schools to step up purchases and causing shortages. A South Korean maker of portable metal detectors said on the 27th that customer inquiries had risen about 100-fold from usual and that the company had sharply raised output but still could not meet demand; another maker said orders placed now would take about half a month to deliver; an online retailer announced that stock had sold out, with restocking expected early next month and only pre-orders accepted. Unable to buy detectors, many schools turned to renting equipment as an emergency measure, with rental companies seeing a marked rise in inquiries; one rental firm's head said detectors were previously rented for events with security requirements, and renting to schools for exam invigilation was a first. According to South Korean sources, more than 80% of university admission places for the 2027 academic year will be filled through early selection, in which high school grades play a key role, yet test-takers often cheat using high-tech devices such as miniature cameras hidden in clothing or personal items, making them hard to detect; hence the ministry requires schools to use metal detectors in in-school exams, and will help schools short of equipment borrow from police and other public institutions or share with nearby schools. IT之家 notes that data released by the ministry on the 27th shows that, as of November 25, 474 cheating cases had been detected in the 2027 academic year College Scholastic Ability Test (the national college entrance exam), up 69.9% from 279 a year earlier; 112 involved smart devices, 3.6 times last year's figure and nearly a quarter of all cases. For serious cheating using smart devices, the ministry filed criminal complaints against 6 test-takers on the 23rd of this month, and plans tougher inspections to stop items that could be used for cheating from being brought into exam rooms at the source; it will also extend the supervision standards for the national exam and in-school exams to the 6 categories of state-level exams it oversees and increase penalties for cheating. IT之家 previously reported that to catch phones not handed in, the South Korean government sent emergency disaster alert text messages to test-takers and the public alike, after which powered-on phones sound a 10.5-second alarm.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映出生成式 AI 与智能设备正在改变考试作弊的形态，并推动监考与硬件管控手段升级。
items.why_en: Speculative: this reflects how generative AI and smart devices are changing the nature of exam cheating and driving upgrades in invigilation and hardware controls.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，据每日经济新闻，对于市场关注的美团与微信小微的试点合作进展，美团 CEO 王兴在财报发布后的业绩电话会上表示， 双方合作正按计划推进 ，双方聚焦本地服务场景，优先打磨微信生态内完整服务链路。 王兴认为，微信 AI 能力叠加美团本地供给与履约能力， 有望挖掘微信生态内新的本地服务需求 。 在 AI 资本开支上，王兴表示，美团将坚持 ROI（投资回报率）导向、审慎投入。王兴透露， 今年已提前锁定部分算力资源，预计明年 AI 相关资本开支将低于今年 ，投入节奏服从整体财务规划，兼顾业务收益与推理成本，持续优化投入效率。 他同时提到，AI 将持续在研发、客服、运营等环节提效，优化平台推荐与服务体验， 中长期来看，AI 带来的降本增效有望逐步覆盖新增投入 。 据IT之家此前报道， 美团今日发布 2026 财年第三财季 （2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）报告： 营业总收入 ：1155.56 亿元，同比增长 21.6%，环比增长 10.4% 毛利润 ：376.84 亿元，同比增长 52.2%，环比增长 7.38% 毛利率 ：32.61%，同比增长 6.57 个百分点，环比下降 0.93 个百分点 归母净利润 ：20.7 亿元，同比扭亏为盈，环比下降 3.93% 经营现金流 ：47.84 亿元 资产负债率 ：56.13% 相关阅读： 《 美团接入微信 AI 生态，未来提供外卖等 AI 生活服务体验 》
items.summary_en: IT之家, November 27: according to National Business Daily, asked about the progress of Meituan's pilot cooperation with WeChat Xiaowei, Meituan CEO Wang Xing said at the post-earnings conference call that the partnership is advancing as planned, with both sides focused on local services scenarios and prioritizing refinement of a complete service chain within the WeChat ecosystem. Wang believes WeChat's AI capabilities combined with Meituan's local supply and fulfillment capabilities could unlock new local service demand within the WeChat ecosystem. On AI capital expenditure, Wang said Meituan will stay ROI-oriented and invest prudently. He said the company secured some computing resources in advance this year and expects AI-related capex next year to be lower than this year, with the pace of investment subject to overall financial planning, balancing business returns and inference costs and continuously improving investment efficiency. He added that AI will keep improving efficiency in R&D, customer service and operations and optimize platform recommendations and service experience, and that over the medium and long term, the cost reduction and efficiency gains from AI are expected to gradually cover the new investment. IT之家 previously reported that Meituan today released its fiscal 2026 third-quarter report (July–September 2026): total revenue of 115.556 billion yuan, up 21.6% year on year and 10.4% quarter on quarter; gross profit of 37.684 billion yuan, up 52.2% year on year and 7.38% quarter on quarter; gross margin of 32.61%, up 6.57 percentage points year on year and down 0.93 percentage points quarter on quarter; net profit attributable to shareholders of 2.07 billion yuan, turning profitable year on year and down 3.93% quarter on quarter; operating cash flow of 4.784 billion yuan; debt-to-asset ratio of 56.13%. Related reading mentions Meituan joining the WeChat AI ecosystem to offer AI life services such as food delivery in the future.
items.why_zh: 推测：头部平台对 AI 投入转向 ROI 导向，可能影响其与微信等生态合作的节奏及行业算力开支预期。
items.why_en: Speculative: a leading platform shifting AI spending toward ROI may affect the pace of its ecosystem partnerships, such as with WeChat, and industry expectations for compute spending.
